meta.title: Apiary Press (Demo)
meta.description: Track beehives and record hive visits, treatments, feedings and harvests. Pre-loaded with a sample rooftop apiary in Vienna so you can explore right away.
meta.author: Francesco Bigiarini

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! post_type_exists( 'ap_apiary' ) || ! post_type_exists( 'ap_hive' ) ) {
	return;
}

$owner    = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$owner_id = $owner ? $owner->ID : 1;
$year     = (int) current_time( 'Y' );

$insert = function ( int $import_id, string $type, string $title, string $content, int $parent, string $date, array $meta ) use ( $owner_id ) {
	$post_id = wp_insert_post( array(
		'import_id'    => $import_id,
		'post_type'    => $type,
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_title'   => $title,
		'post_content' => $content,
		'post_parent'  => $parent,
		'post_author'  => $owner_id,
		'post_date'    => $date,
	), true );
	if ( is_wp_error( $post_id ) ) {
		return 0;
	}
	foreach ( $meta as $key => $value ) {
		update_post_meta( $post_id, $key, $value );
	}
	return (int) $post_id;
};

$apiary = $insert( 9001, 'ap_apiary', 'Rooftop Apiary', 'Three hives on a flat roof in the centre of Vienna. Early flow from the chestnuts and maples in the parks, then the linden trees in June.', 0, ( $year - 2 ) . '-04-10 12:00:00', array() );
if ( ! $apiary ) {
	return;
}

$hives = array(
	9011 => array( 'Stephansdom', 'Strong overwintered colony, two brood boxes.', array( 'latitude' => 48.208391, 'longitude' => 16.372713, 'queen_year' => $year - 1, 'queen_marked' => '1', 'queen_clipped' => '0', 'queen_origin' => 'Own breeding', 'queen_installed_at' => ( $year - 1 ) . '-06-14' ) ),
	9012 => array( 'Haas Haus', 'Swarm caught last summer. Gentle and building up well.', array( 'latitude' => 48.208342, 'longitude' => 16.371592, 'queen_year' => $year - 1, 'queen_marked' => '0', 'queen_clipped' => '0', 'queen_origin' => 'Swarm', 'queen_installed_at' => ( $year - 1 ) . '-07-02' ) ),
	9013 => array( 'Rotenturmstraße', 'Older queen, keep an eye on the brood pattern.', array( 'latitude' => 48.2091, 'longitude' => 16.3733, 'queen_year' => $year - 3, 'queen_marked' => '1', 'queen_clipped' => '1', 'queen_origin' => 'Purchased', 'queen_installed_at' => ( $year - 3 ) . '-05-20' ) ),
);
foreach ( $hives as $id => $h ) {
	$insert( $id, 'ap_hive', $h[0], $h[1], $apiary, ( $year - 2 ) . '-04-10 12:00:00', $h[2] );
}

$visits = array(
	array( 9021, 9011, 'Spring inspection', 'First full inspection of the year. Six frames of brood, plenty of stores left.', "$year-03-28 10:30:00", 'routine_inspection', array( 'saw_queen', 'eggs', 'larvae', 'capped_brood' ) ),
	array( 9022, 9011, 'Added first super', 'Colony is bursting, added a super with drawn comb.', "$year-04-20 11:00:00", 'add_remove_super', array( 'eggs', 'larvae', 'capped_brood', 'added_super' ) ),
	array( 9023, 9011, 'Swarm check', 'Found two charged queen cells on frame 5. Removed them and gave more space.', "$year-05-11 09:45:00", 'swarm_check', array( 'saw_queen', 'eggs', 'queen_cells', 'check_soon' ) ),
	array( 9024, 9011, 'Harvest', 'Took the spring honey. Bees calm, warm and still up on the roof.', "$year-06-05 14:00:00", 'honey_harvest', array( 'capped_brood' ) ),
	array( 9025, 9012, 'Spring inspection', 'Smaller than the Stephansdom colony, but the queen is laying a tidy pattern on four frames.', "$year-03-28 11:15:00", 'routine_inspection', array( 'eggs', 'larvae', 'capped_brood' ) ),
	array( 9026, 9012, 'Varroa count', 'Sugar roll gave 2 mites per 100 bees. Still low.', "$year-05-18 10:00:00", 'varroa_monitoring_treatment', array( 'saw_queen', 'eggs' ) ),
	array( 9027, 9013, 'Queen check', 'Spotty brood pattern and a few drone cells in worker comb. Might need requeening this summer.', "$year-04-02 10:00:00", 'queen_check', array( 'saw_queen', 'capped_brood', 'check_soon' ) ),
	array( 9028, 9013, 'Food stores check', 'Stores getting low after a cold week, gave syrup.', "$year-04-24 16:30:00", 'food_stores_check', array( 'larvae', 'check_soon' ) ),
);
foreach ( $visits as $v ) {
	$meta = array( 'reason' => $v[5] );
	foreach ( array( 'added_super', 'capped_brood', 'check_soon', 'eggs', 'larvae', 'queen_cells', 'saw_queen' ) as $key ) {
		$meta[ $key ] = in_array( $key, $v[6], true ) ? '1' : '0';
	}
	$insert( $v[0], 'ap_hive_visit', $v[2], $v[3], $v[1], $v[4], $meta );
}

$treatments = array(
	array( 9031, 9011, 'Oxalic acid trickle', 'Broodless winter treatment.', "$year-01-08 12:00:00", array( 'kind' => 'treatment', 'product' => 'Oxalic acid', 'target' => 'varroa', 'quantity' => 50, 'unit' => 'ml', 'end_date' => '' ) ),
	array( 9032, 9012, 'Formic acid', 'Summer treatment after the varroa count.', "$year-07-20 12:00:00", array( 'kind' => 'treatment', 'product' => 'Formic acid 60%', 'target' => 'varroa', 'quantity' => 2, 'unit' => 'doses', 'end_date' => "$year-07-27" ) ),
	array( 9033, 9013, 'Spring feeding', 'Light syrup to bridge the cold spell.', "$year-04-24 12:00:00", array( 'kind' => 'feeding', 'product' => 'Sugar syrup 1:1', 'target' => '', 'quantity' => 3, 'unit' => 'l', 'end_date' => '' ) ),
	array( 9034, 9012, 'Autumn feeding', 'Winter stores.', "$year-09-05 12:00:00", array( 'kind' => 'feeding', 'product' => 'Sugar syrup 3:2', 'target' => '', 'quantity' => 12, 'unit' => 'kg', 'end_date' => "$year-09-19" ) ),
);
foreach ( $treatments as $t ) {
	$insert( $t[0], 'ap_hive_treatment', $t[2], $t[3], $t[1], $t[4], $t[5] );
}

$harvests = array(
	array( 9041, 9011, 'Spring city honey', 'Light and floral from the park trees and balcony flowers.', "$year-06-05 12:00:00", array( 'quantity_kg' => 14.5, 'honey_type' => 'Spring blossom', 'frames_extracted' => 9, 'extraction_method' => 'extractor' ) ),
	array( 9042, 9011, 'Linden honey', 'Darker and minty from the linden avenues.', "$year-07-18 12:00:00", array( 'quantity_kg' => 11, 'honey_type' => 'Linden', 'frames_extracted' => 8, 'extraction_method' => 'extractor' ) ),
	array( 9043, 9012, 'Summer honey', 'First harvest from this colony.', "$year-07-18 12:00:00", array( 'quantity_kg' => 6.2, 'honey_type' => 'City blossom', 'frames_extracted' => 4, 'extraction_method' => 'extractor' ) ),
);
foreach ( $harvests as $h ) {
	$insert( $h[0], 'ap_hive_harvest', $h[2], $h[3], $h[1], $h[4], $h[5] );
}
